name: Sanctuary Pin
summary: A mosque is carved through a continuous rounded location pin, combining place and prayer in one bold emblem.
why: The mosque is true negative space inside the pin, with its doorway left solid and joined to the lower pin. Dome, doorway, low side towers and pin point all balance around x=54.
risk: The location-pin meaning is prominent. At 24px the carved architecture is simpler; it is more explicit at 48px.
sub1: The mosque is cut directly through the pin
sub2: The pin remains bold in a single color
theme: Soft mosque architecture and location pin
reasonToChoose: A mosque is carved through a continuous rounded location pin, combining place and prayer in one bold emblem.
